Players Committee card image of [[Commander Brandei (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if Judicator). Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each TIE subtype here or aboard same starship. During your turn, may ▲ one launch bay or non-unique TIE.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/commanderbrandei.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/commanderbrandei.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
